An anchor split around a block keeps the half that carries its text

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<a href=\"/o\">Text<div><a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
